# Diego Appraiser (diego-appraiser.com)

> City of San Diego site of Brian Ward Appraisal. Brian Ward is a California Certified Residential Real Estate Appraiser (since 2004, 7,000+ appraisals) providing non-lending residential appraisals: date of death, estate & trust, divorce, bankruptcy, expert witness, tax, pre-purchase, pre-sale, family transaction, insurance dispute, immigration and bail bond. Covers all City of San Diego neighborhoods and all of San Diego County. Phone (619) 630-9273. Email contact@diego-appraiser.com. Main site: https://www.brianward.com

## Pricing (starting)
- Basic Desktop: $299
- Desktop Appraisal: $449
- Drive-By Appraisal: $649
- Standard (Single Family): $699
- Desktop (2–4 Unit): $549
- Standard (2–4 Unit): $799

## Services
- [Date of Death Appraisals](https://www.diego-appraiser.com/appraisals/date-of-death/): A retrospective appraisal that pins down what a San Diego house was worth on the date its owner died, for stepped-up basis, estate filings and fair division among heirs.
- [Estate & Trust Appraisals](https://www.diego-appraiser.com/appraisals/estate-trust/): Independent valuations of San Diego homes held in an estate or living trust, prepared for trustees, heirs and advisors who must divide, distribute, sell or account for real property.
- [Divorce Appraisals](https://www.diego-appraiser.com/appraisals/divorce/): Neutral, court-ready valuations of a San Diego marital home or rental property, prepared for spouses, attorneys and mediators working out a property division or buyout.
- [Bankruptcy Appraisals](https://www.diego-appraiser.com/appraisals/bankruptcy/): Supported market values for San Diego homes and small rental buildings in Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 cases, written for debtors, attorneys and trustees reviewing scheduled equity.
- [Expert Witness & Litigation Support](https://www.diego-appraiser.com/appraisals/expert-witness/): Real estate valuation opinions, report reviews and courtroom testimony from a California certified residential appraiser, for San Diego attorneys handling property-related disputes and lawsuits.
- [Tax Appraisals](https://www.diego-appraiser.com/appraisals/tax/): Appraisals for property tax appeals, gift tax filings, charitable donations and capital gains basis questions, covering San Diego homes, condos and small rental buildings.
- [Pre-Purchase Appraisals](https://www.diego-appraiser.com/appraisals/pre-purchase/): An independent value opinion for San Diego buyers who want to know what a home is really worth before they write an offer or remove their appraisal contingency.
- [Pre-Sale Appraisals](https://www.diego-appraiser.com/appraisals/pre-sale/): An independent market value for San Diego owners preparing to sell, so pricing, repair choices and buyer appraisal risks are understood before the home goes on the market.
- [Family Transaction Appraisals](https://www.diego-appraiser.com/appraisals/family-transaction/): Independent appraisals for San Diego homes transferred, sold or shared among relatives, supporting fair pricing, gift reporting, Proposition 19 questions and buyouts.
- [Insurance Dispute Appraisals](https://www.diego-appraiser.com/appraisals/insurance-dispute/): Before-and-after market value analysis for San Diego homeowners, adjusters and attorneys sorting out real estate losses from fire, water, flood, slope movement or other covered events.
- [Immigration Appraisals](https://www.diego-appraiser.com/appraisals/immigration/): Documented market values for San Diego real estate used as financial evidence in immigration matters, including sponsor asset declarations and proof of funds requirements.
- [Bail Bond Appraisals](https://www.diego-appraiser.com/appraisals/bail-bond/): Fast, supported valuations of San Diego real estate offered as collateral for bail, prepared so bondsmen, courts and families can confirm equity quickly.
